> 标签: adapter, bun, cache, caching, compression, esm, high-performance, key-value, memory, nuvix, performance, redis, telemetry, ttl, typescript

## 简介

A high-performance, Bun-native caching library with a zero-dependency Redis adapter, compression, tagging, and telemetry integration
